metadata.name: Sediment Chemical Analysis from Belgian Collector Trial
metadata.description: This dataset contains chemical analysis of sediment samples collected from a single location in the Belgian collector trial pre-impact area. It includes measurements of various elements (e.g., Al, Ba, Fe, Cu) and their relative errors, as well as squared values of these elements. The data is associated with a single core sample (Core 18) and covers a sediment depth range from 0.0625 to 0.225 meters. All samples were collected at the same geographic location (Latitude: 14.13508333, Longitude: -125.86365) and time (2019-03-20 02:30:12).
